access_review.summary: Will of the council abilities have players vote, starting with you, and use the vote totals to determine their effects. Each card specifies its choices and how ties are handled.

W.note: Council's Judgment exiles each voted-for nonland permanent you don’t control with the most votes or tied for the most votes.

U.note: Plea for Power gives you an extra turn if time gets more votes; knowledge winning or a tie draws you three cards instead.

B.note: Tyrant's Choice has each opponent sacrifice a creature if death gets more votes; torture winning or a tie makes each opponent lose 4 life instead.

R.note: No independent example found in the reviewed scope.

combinations.note: When Magister of Worth enters, a grace majority returns every creature card from each player’s graveyard to the battlefield; condemnation winning or a tie destroys every other creature instead.

Sail into the West returns up to two cards from each player’s graveyard to their hand and exiles itself if return gets more votes; embark winning or a tie lets each player discard their hand and draw seven cards instead.

colorless.note: At the beginning of your upkeep, Coercive Portal sacrifices itself and destroys all nonland permanents if carnage gets more votes; homage winning or a tie draws you a card.

Target player draws four cards.
Will of the Planeswalkers — Starting with you, each player votes for planeswalk or chaos. If planeswalk gets more votes, planeswalk. If chaos gets more votes or the vote is tied, chaos ensues.
card_facts.flavor_text: "We were caught unprepared once. I won't let it happen again."

card_review.name: Path of the Schemer
card_review.inclusion_reason: Path of the Schemer has each player mill two cards, then returns a creature card from a graveyard to the battlefield under your control as an artifact in addition to its other types, before the vote.

card_facts.name: Path of the Schemer
card_facts.oracle_text:
Each player mills two cards. Then you put a creature card from a graveyard onto the battlefield under your control. It's an artifact in addition to its other types.
Will of the Planeswalkers — Starting with you, each player votes for planeswalk or chaos. If planeswalk gets more votes, planeswalk. If chaos gets more votes or the vote is tied, chaos ensues.

card_review.name: Path of the Pyromancer
card_review.inclusion_reason: Path of the Pyromancer discards your hand, adds {R} for each card discarded, then draws that many cards plus one before the vote.

card_facts.name: Path of the Pyromancer
card_facts.oracle_text:
Discard all the cards in your hand. Add {R} for each card discarded this way, then draw that many cards plus one.
Will of the Planeswalkers — Starting with you, each player votes for planeswalk or chaos. If planeswalk gets more votes, planeswalk. If chaos gets more votes or the vote is tied, chaos ensues.

card_review.name: Path of the Animist
card_review.inclusion_reason: Path of the Animist searches your library for up to two basic lands, puts them onto the battlefield tapped, then shuffles before the vote.

card_facts.name: Path of the Animist
card_facts.oracle_text:
Search your library for up to two basic land cards, put them onto the battlefield tapped, then shuffle.
Will of the Planeswalkers — Starting with you, each player votes for planeswalk or chaos. If planeswalk gets more votes, planeswalk. If chaos gets more votes or the vote is tied, chaos ensues.
